title: Advies geven
summary: je moet, je kunt beter, a soft preview of zou moeten, and neem rust

blocks.title: Je moet… — direct advies
blocks.body: **Je moet** + infinitive is the strongest advice: a real 'you must/should'. *Je moet naar de huisarts gaan* (You must go to the GP). Blunt, but normal between friends — Dutch directness isn't rude, it's just honest.
blocks.callout: *Je moet* — no sugar-coating needed, that's the Dutch way.

items.target: Je kunt beter naar bed gaan.
items.speak: Je kunt beter naar bed gaan.

blocks.title: Je kunt beter… — de zachtere suggestie
blocks.body: **Je kunt beter** + infinitive (literally 'you can better') softens the advice into a suggestion: *Je kunt beter water drinken* (You'd better drink water). Less of an order than *je moet*, more of a nudge.
blocks.callout: *kunt beter* — beter (better) turns 'can' into a gentle 'should'.

blocks.prompt: Which is the gentlest way to suggest someone rest?
blocks.explain: Je kunt beter softens the advice into a suggestion rather than a command.

pairs.left: Je moet rusten. — You must rest. (direct)
pairs.right: Je zou moeten rusten. — You should rest. (softer, hypothetical)
pairs.note: Zou is a first taste of the conditional (more on this later). Je zou moeten = a gentle 'should', good for advice you don't want to force.

blocks.explain: Neem rust — the bare stem 'neem' as a command, no 'je' needed.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.
blocks.speak: Je kunt beter naar bed gaan.
answers: je kunt beter naar bed gaan

blocks.scene: Emma notices you look terrible and gives you a stack of advice

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Joh, je ziet er niet goed uit. Wat is er?
lines.en: Hey, you don't look good. What's wrong?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Ik heb hoofdpijn en ik voel me heel moe.
lines.en: I have a headache and I feel very tired.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Je moet echt naar bed, hoor.
lines.en: You really must go to bed.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Ik heb morgen toch een afspraak.
lines.en: But I have an appointment tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Die kun je beter verzetten. Neem rust, drink veel water.
lines.en: You'd better reschedule that. Take a rest, drink lots of water.
lines.spotlight: kunt beter + the classic neem rust

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Oké, oké. Misschien zou ik ook naar de huisarts moeten gaan.
lines.en: Okay, okay. Maybe I should also go to the GP.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Goed idee. Bel morgenvroeg maar even.
lines.en: Good idea. Just call tomorrow morning.

What does 'You' consider doing at the end?

blocks.prompt: A friend texts you that they feel terrible. Write two pieces of advice — one with je moet, one with je kunt beter.
